description: This header file declares utility functions for parsing and comparing version strings, specifically designed for device descriptors within the Zilker SDK. It provides functions to convert version strings into integer arrays and compare different version representations.
external_methods: int8_t compareVersionArrays(uint32_t *left, uint16_t leftLen, uint32_t *right, uint16_t rightLen)

methods.name: versionStringToInt
methods.description: Parses a version string into an array of integers, splitting on non-digit characters.

methods.name: compareVersionArrays
methods.description: Compares two version integer arrays to determine their relative order.

methods.name: compareVersionStrings
methods.description: Compares two version strings directly by their version semantics.
